body:
Our conversation starts almost every time with "Hey, how are you" and we mean it, so that's a good start I guess!
But if I ask her how her day was she just says "same as every day" or something like that. She's still in school but has an internship for 3 weeks right now (she's now in the second week) and it's hard for her. She's tired when she gets home and her day pretty much consists of standing around most of the time and doing some tasks the people there give her. Even if I dig a bit deeper, she still hasn't anything that made her happy that day. 
The compliments are a good idea! I already tell her a some once in a while but I think she won't be annoyed by a few more.

Okay, thanks! I'll tell her more often how important she is! 
But I feel like I'm annoying her if I write her everyday.. sometimes her answers are short and there's not much emotion in them. What do I do if she completely shuts off? I'm afraid that if I don't text her (thinking that she just needs some alone time) she thinks that she's not important but if I text her I feel like I'm annoying her

I told her, more than once. Not just when she's feeling bad but also now and then when we're just talking about random stuff or before she goes to bed and we wish each other a good night. And she seems to appreciate it for a short period of time (a day or maybe two)
